verdict.rationale: Docs mention 'Template Variables' and 'Recipient Variables' for personalizing batch/mailing-list sends (mailgun-docs-14, mailgun-docs-15), showing basic merge-field support, but there is no documented templating language with conditionals/loops, and no evidence of a preview or test-render feature. missing for 10: documented conditional/loop syntax, template preview/test-render tool, independent corroboration.
